scenes.caption: The thread runs from chair to fan and the rocket whooshes up. Her laugh fills the room.
scenes.image_brief: A yellow balloon taped to a straw shooting up a slanted thread that runs from a chair back to a ceiling fan hook, the girl with red-ribboned plaits below with both arms up and her mouth open in a laugh

scenes.narration: अब भाई भी डोरी पकड़कर साथ खेलता है। फूँक भरो, ऊपर चलो!
scenes.caption: Now her little brother holds the thread and plays too. Fill it, up it goes!
scenes.image_brief: The toddler boy in the blue vest holding the low end of the thread taut while the girl in the purple frock kneels beside him with a fresh yellow balloon, the ceiling fan above them, warm evening light

title: 🍳 युग का चकला दो टुकड़ों में टूटा... गोल रोटी अब कैसे बनेगी? #hindikids #khel
title_alts: 🤝 युग और ईरा ने मिलकर टूटा चकला थामा... फिर क्या बना? #hindikids #khel
🌾 लोई बेलन पर लिपट गई और बस एक लोई बची... युग ने किसे बुलाया? #hindikids #khel
description_hook: युग की लोई बेलन के गिर्द लिपट गई और चकला मेज़ से लुढ़ककर टूट गया। बस एक लोई बची थी, और ईरा पास ही बैठी थी।

characters.name: युग
characters.description: four-year-old boy, round face and straight fringe, blue denim dungarees over a white t-shirt, flour on both palms

characters.name: ईरा
characters.description: five-year-old girl, curly hair in a top knot, green kurta and orange leggings

scenes.narration: युग खिलौना रसोई में गोल रोटी बेलना चाहता है।
scenes.caption: Yug wants to roll one round flatbread in his toy kitchen.
scenes.image_brief: A four-year-old boy with a straight fringe in blue denim dungarees over a white t-shirt, sitting cross-legged on a veranda play mat with a small wooden rolling board, a toy rolling pin and a ball of pale dough

scenes.narration: युग ने बेलन आगे घुमाया, पर आटा चकले पर चिपक गया। चकला थामो, बेलन घुमाओ!
scenes.caption: He rolls the pin forward but the dough glues itself to the board.
scenes.image_brief: Close view of small hands pressing a toy wooden rolling pin over a flattened lump of dough that clings to a miniature wooden board, fingerprints pressed into the sticky edge

scenes.narration: उसने दोनों हाथ दबाकर ज़ोर लगाया। लोई बेलन के गिर्द लिपट गई। क्या तुम साथ घुमाओगे?
scenes.caption: He presses with both hands and the dough wraps right around the pin.
scenes.image_brief: A toy rolling pin lifted off the board with a thick collar of dough wound around its middle, the boy in dungarees holding it up in front of his puzzled face on the veranda mat

scenes.narration: चकला मेज़ से लुढ़का और दो टुकड़ों में टूट गया।
scenes.caption: The little board rolls off the table and cracks in two.
scenes.image_brief: A miniature wooden rolling board lying on veranda tiles split cleanly into two halves, a dusting of flour around the break, the boy's bare feet just behind it

scenes.narration: बस एक लोई बची। युग बुदबुदाया, चकला थामो, बेलन घुमाओ!
scenes.caption: One last ball of dough remains. He mutters the rolling chant.
scenes.image_brief: A single pale ball of dough sitting alone in a steel bowl, the boy in blue dungarees resting his chin on the rim of the bowl and looking at it, soft morning light on the veranda

scenes.narration: युग ईरा से कहता है, और ईरा दोनों टुकड़े कसकर थाम लेती है। युग सूखा आटा छिड़ककर बेलन घुमाता है।
scenes.caption: He asks Ira, she clamps the two halves tight, and he dusts dry flour and rolls.
scenes.image_brief: A five-year-old girl with curly hair in a top knot, green kurta and orange leggings, pressing two halves of a wooden board together on the mat while the boy in dungarees sprinkles dry flour and rolls the toy pin across the seam

scenes.narration: दो गोल रोटियाँ तैयार हुईं, एक युग की और एक ईरा की। दोनों की आँखें चमक उठीं।
scenes.caption: Two neat round flatbreads come out, one each. Both pairs of eyes shine.
scenes.image_brief: Two flat round discs of pale dough side by side on the mended wooden board, the boy in dungarees and the girl in the green kurta leaning over them shoulder to shoulder with wide bright eyes

scenes.narration: अब दोनों मिलकर बेलते हैं। चकला थामो, बेलन घुमाओ!
scenes.caption: Now the two of them roll together. Hold the board, turn the pin!
scenes.image_brief: The girl in the green kurta steadying the wooden board with both hands while the boy in blue dungarees pushes the toy rolling pin across it, a small stack of dough discs beside their knees on the veranda mat

title: 🔭 दीक्षा की दूरबीन का कांच पलंग के नीचे लुढ़का... गौरैया कैसे दिखी? #hindikids #khel
title_alts: 🐦 गौरैया फुर्र से उड़ गई... दीक्षा ने खिड़की पर क्या सजाया? #hindikids #khel
💧 दूर की डाल छोड़कर दीक्षा ने पास की कटोरी भरी... फिर तीन मेहमान आए! #hindikids #khel
description_hook: दीक्षा की खिलौना दूरबीन से डाल धुंधली ही रही, और फिर छल्ला ढीला होकर कांच पलंग के नीचे लुढ़क गया। उसी बीच गौरैया भी उड़ गई।

characters.name: दीक्षा
characters.description: six-year-old girl, pink hairband, yellow kurta and blue leggings, a short wooden toy telescope on a cord round her neck

scenes.narration: दीक्षा दूर की डाल पर बैठी गौरैया को दूरबीन से देखना चाहती है।
scenes.caption: Deeksha wants to see the sparrow on the far branch through her toy telescope.
scenes.image_brief: A six-year-old girl with a pink hairband, yellow kurta and blue leggings, kneeling on a bedroom window sill and raising a short wooden toy telescope toward a tall tree across a garden

scenes.narration: दीक्षा ने नली आँख पर लगाई, पर पत्ते धुंधले ही रहे।
scenes.caption: She holds the tube to her eye but the leaves stay blurred.
scenes.image_brief: View along a wooden toy telescope held to a child's eye, the green tree canopy beyond the window soft and out of focus, one small hand steadying the tube

scenes.narration: उसने कांच रुमाल से पोंछा और फिर झाँका। डाल अब भी खाली दिखी।
scenes.caption: She wipes the lens with a handkerchief. The branch is still bare.
scenes.image_brief: A bare grey branch swaying against a pale sky seen through an open window, a folded white handkerchief and a hollow wooden tube lying on the sill in the foreground

scenes.narration: दूरबीन का छल्ला ढीला हुआ, कांच खिसककर पलंग के नीचे लुढ़क गया।
scenes.caption: The ring works loose and the little lens rolls under the bed.
scenes.image_brief: A small round glass lens rolling across a wooden floor into the shadow under a bed frame, an empty brass ring and a hollow wooden tube left behind on the rug

scenes.narration: गौरैया फुर्र से उड़ गई। दीक्षा ने धीमे से कहा, दाना रखो, चिड़िया बुलाओ! क्या तुम भी रखोगे?
scenes.caption: The sparrow flits away. She says the seed chant softly. Will you set some out too?
scenes.image_brief: An empty branch with a single loose feather drifting down, the girl with the pink hairband watching from the window sill with her chin on her folded arms

scenes.narration: दीक्षा दूरबीन रखकर खिड़की पर कटोरी में पानी और मुट्ठी भर दाना सजाती है।
scenes.caption: Deeksha puts the telescope down and sets out a bowl of water and a fistful of seed.
scenes.image_brief: The girl in the yellow kurta and pink hairband placing a small steel bowl of water on a window sill and tipping a handful of golden grain beside it, the wooden tube lying forgotten behind her

scenes.narration: तीन गौरैया कटोरी पर उतरीं, इतनी पास कि पंख गिने जाएँ। दीक्षा चुपचाप मुस्कुराती रही, दाना रखो, चिड़िया बुलाओ!
scenes.caption: Three sparrows land close enough to count their feathers. She smiles without a sound.
scenes.image_brief: Three small brown sparrows perched on the rim of a steel water bowl on a sunlit window sill, one dipping its beak, the girl with the pink hairband watching from a hand's width away

scenes.narration: अब दीक्षा रोज़ कटोरी भरती है। दाना रखो, चिड़िया बुलाओ!
scenes.caption: Now she fills the bowl every morning. Set the seed, call the birds!
scenes.image_brief: The girl in the yellow kurta pouring water from a small jug into the sill bowl at sunrise, scattered grain around it and two sparrows waiting on the window grille

title: 🐤 मयंक के दाने मेज़ से लुढ़क गए... चाबी वाली चिड़िया अब क्या करेगी? #hindikids #khel
title_alts: 🥁 चोंच हर दाने से फिसली, पर उलटी थाली पर कुछ और हुआ! #hindikids #khel
🎶 मयंक ने चिड़िया को स्टील की थाली पर बिठाया... फिर घर में कौन नाचा? #hindikids #khel
description_hook: मयंक की चाबी वाली चिड़िया कालीन पर टस से मस नहीं हुई, और मेज़ पर उसकी चोंच हर दाने से फिसल गई। बस एक दाना बचा था।

characters.name: मयंक
characters.description: five-year-old boy, bowl-cut hair, yellow polo shirt and brown shorts

scenes.narration: मयंक चाहता है कि चाबी वाली चिड़िया मेज़ पर दाना चुगे।
scenes.caption: Mayank wants his windup bird to peck grain on the table.
scenes.image_brief: A five-year-old boy with bowl-cut hair in a yellow polo shirt and brown shorts, leaning over a wooden study table where a small tin windup bird stands beside a neat pile of golden grain

scenes.narration: मयंक ने चाबी घुमाकर चिड़िया कालीन पर रखी। वह टस से मस नहीं हुई।
scenes.caption: He winds the key and sets it on the carpet. It does not budge.
scenes.image_brief: Close view of a tin windup bird sinking into deep woolly carpet pile, its thin wire feet buried, the boy's fingers still on the little key at its side

scenes.narration: मेज़ पर चिड़िया फुदकी, पर चोंच हर दाने से फिसल गई। क्या तुम चाबी घुमाओगे?
scenes.caption: On the table it hops, but the beak skids off every grain. Will you wind the key?
scenes.image_brief: A tin bird tilting forward on a polished wooden table, its pointed beak sliding past a scattered row of golden grains, one grain spinning on its edge

scenes.narration: पंख की टक्कर से सारे दाने मेज़ से लुढ़ककर फ़र्श पर बिखर गए।
scenes.caption: A wing knocks the grains off the table and they scatter on the floor.
scenes.image_brief: Golden grains bouncing off the edge of a wooden table onto floor tiles below, the tin bird still rocking near the empty tabletop, the boy's knees at the table edge

scenes.narration: बस एक दाना बचा। मयंक ने पुकारा, चाबी घुमाओ, ताल सुनाओ!
scenes.caption: One single grain is left. He calls out the winding chant.
scenes.image_brief: One lone golden grain on a wide bare wooden table, the boy with bowl-cut hair resting his cheek flat on the table looking straight at it

scenes.narration: मयंक स्टील की थाली उलटकर चिड़िया को उसके ऊपर बिठा देता है।
scenes.caption: Mayank turns a steel plate upside down and stands the bird on it.
scenes.image_brief: The boy in the yellow polo shirt setting a tin windup bird on top of an upturned steel plate on the wooden table, the last grain resting beside the plate rim

scenes.narration: चोंच थाली पर टन-टन बजने लगी। मयंक दाना भूलकर खिलखिलाकर उसी ताल पर नाचा, चाबी घुमाओ, ताल सुनाओ!
scenes.caption: The beak taps a bright ting-ting and he forgets the grain and dances to the beat.
scenes.image_brief: A tin bird tapping its beak on an upturned steel plate, the boy with bowl-cut hair spinning on one foot beside the table with his arms out, laughing

scenes.narration: अब चिड़िया मयंक का नन्हा ढोलक है। चाबी घुमाओ, ताल सुनाओ!
scenes.caption: Now the bird is his tiny drummer. Wind the key, play the beat!
scenes.image_brief: The tin windup bird standing in the middle of an upturned steel plate on a wooden table in warm lamplight, the boy's hand reaching in to turn its key

title: 🎠 प्राची का घोड़ा पहले ही धक्के में दौड़ा, फिर टाइल पर फिसला... अब कैसे? #hindikids #khel
title_alts: 🤔 प्राची को लंबी सवारी तुरंत मिल गई, पर घोड़ा मेज़ से क्यों टकराया? #hindikids #khel
🏡 बैठक में सवारी बंद, बरामदा खाली... प्राची का घोड़ा कहाँ जमेगा? #hindikids #khel
description_hook: प्राची का काठ का घोड़ा पहले ही धक्के में दौड़ पड़ा। फिर पाटा चिकनी टाइल पर फिसला और एक खूंटा ढीला हो गया।

characters.name: प्राची
characters.description: four-year-old girl, two short braids tied with red ribbons, a blue frock with white dots, bare feet

scenes.narration: प्राची को काठ के घोड़े पर आज लंबी सवारी चाहिए। पहली बार अकेले।
scenes.caption: Prachi wants one long ride on the wooden horse today. Alone, the first time.
scenes.image_brief: Prachi, a four-year-old girl with two short braids tied with red ribbons, a blue frock with white dots and bare feet, stands beside a painted wooden rocking horse in a living room of glossy cream floor tiles, one hand on its red saddle, morning light through an open door.

scenes.narration: पहले ही धक्के में घोड़ा दौड़ पड़ा। आगे झूला, पीछे झूला! फिर पाटा चिकनी टाइल पर फिसला।
scenes.caption: The very first push sets it rocking hard. Then a runner skids on the smooth tile.
scenes.image_brief: Prachi, a four-year-old girl with two short braids tied with red ribbons, a blue frock with white dots and bare feet, leaning forward in the saddle of the rocking horse mid-swing, its curved wooden runner sliding sideways across the glossy tiles, a low sofa behind.

scenes.narration: प्राची ने लगाम कसकर खींची, पर घोड़ा जगह पर रुका नहीं। क्या तुम भी झूल सकते हो?
scenes.caption: She pulls the reins tight, and the horse will not stay put.
scenes.image_brief: Prachi, a four-year-old girl with two short braids tied with red ribbons, a blue frock with white dots and bare feet, gripping the red rope reins with both fists, knuckles pale, the wooden horse drifting a whole tile away from where it started.

scenes.narration: घोड़ा फिसलकर मेज़ से टकराया, और एक खूंटा ढीला हो गया।
scenes.caption: The horse slides into the table and one wooden peg works loose.
scenes.image_brief: Close view of a wooden rocking horse nudged against the leg of a low table, a small round peg half out of its hole in the runner, a fallen coaster on the tiles beside it.

scenes.narration: माँ ने हद बाँध दी: बैठक में सवारी बंद। बरामदा खाली था।
scenes.caption: A rule arrives: no riding in the living room. The verandah lay empty.
scenes.image_brief: A woman's hand setting the wooden rocking horse aside by the living room doorway, an empty sunlit verandah with a rolled cotton rug beyond the threshold, tiles shining.

scenes.narration: प्राची दो मोटे रबड़ बैंड पाटों पर लपेटती है और घोड़े को बरामदे की दरी पर जमाती है।
scenes.caption: She winds two thick rubber bands round the runners and settles the horse on the verandah rug.
scenes.image_brief: Prachi, a four-year-old girl with two short braids tied with red ribbons, a blue frock with white dots and bare feet, kneeling on an unrolled striped cotton rug on the verandah, stretching a thick rubber band around the curved wooden runner of the rocking horse.

scenes.narration: घोड़ा अपनी जगह मस्त झूलने लगा। आगे झूला, पीछे झूला! प्राची की हँसी नहीं रुकती।
scenes.caption: Now it rocks happily and stays. Prachi cannot stop laughing.
scenes.image_brief: Prachi, a four-year-old girl with two short braids tied with red ribbons, a blue frock with white dots and bare feet, rocking on the wooden horse on the striped verandah rug, head thrown back laughing, the runners staying exactly in place, plants in pots along the verandah wall.

scenes.narration: प्राची की दरी वाली सवारी सबसे लंबी चली। आगे झूला, पीछे झूला!
scenes.caption: The rug ride was her longest yet. Forward swing, back swing!
scenes.image_brief: The painted wooden rocking horse resting steady on a striped cotton rug on a sunlit verandah, two rubber bands visible on its runners, Prachi, a four-year-old girl with two short braids tied with red ribbons, a blue frock with white dots and bare feet, sitting cross-legged beside it.

title: 🐢 अवनि की हरी मिट्टी ख़त्म, खोल टूट गया... कछुआ किसे मिलेगा? #hindikids #khel
title_alts: 🤝 अवनि ने रिया से क्या सौदा किया, और कछुआ किसकी हथेली पर गया? #hindikids #khel
🟡 बची थी बस पीली मिट्टी, फिर कछुआ चारों पैरों पर कैसे खड़ा हुआ? #hindikids #khel
description_hook: अवनि का हरा खोल धूप में सूखकर टूट गया और डिब्बा ख़ाली हो गया। मेज़ पर बची थी बस पीली मिट्टी।

characters.name: अवनि
characters.description: five-year-old girl, short bob haircut, yellow frock with green buttons, clay under her fingernails

characters.name: रिया
characters.description: three-year-old neighbour girl, single top-knot, pink kurta

scenes.narration: अवनि को हरी मिट्टी का एक कछुआ चाहिए, चारों पैरों पर खड़ा।
scenes.caption: Avani wants one green clay turtle that stands on all four feet.
scenes.image_brief: Avani, a five-year-old girl with a short bob and a yellow frock with green buttons, at a craft table by a bright window, rolling a ball of green clay between her palms, four small yellow clay paws lined up on a wooden board.

scenes.narration: अवनि खोल को पैरों पर बैठाती है। गोल खोल, नन्हे पैर! पैर चपटे हो गए।
scenes.caption: She sets the shell down onto the paws. The paws squash flat.
scenes.image_brief: Avani, a five-year-old girl with a short bob and a yellow frock with green buttons, pressing a round green clay dome onto four tiny yellow paws that are spreading out flat under its weight on a wooden craft board.

scenes.narration: अवनि पैरों में दो सींकें डालती है, पर खोल एक ओर लुढ़क जाता है। क्या तुम चार पैर गिन सकते हो?
scenes.caption: She pushes two matchsticks into the legs, and the shell rolls off sideways.
scenes.image_brief: Avani, a five-year-old girl with a short bob and a yellow frock with green buttons, holding two thin wooden sticks she has pushed into the clay paws, the green dome tilting off one side onto the board, window light across the table.

scenes.narration: हरी मिट्टी का डिब्बा ख़ाली हो गया। बस पीली मिट्टी बची।
scenes.caption: The tub of green clay is empty. Only yellow is left.
scenes.image_brief: An open empty plastic tub with a smear of green clay inside, beside a full tub of yellow clay on a craft table, a wooden sculpting stick lying across both.

scenes.narration: धूप में रखा खोल सूखकर बीच से टूट गया।
scenes.caption: Left in the sun, the shell dries and breaks down the middle.
scenes.image_brief: Close view of a dried green clay dome split into two pieces on a sunlit windowsill, fine cracks along both halves, crumbs of clay around them.

scenes.narration: अवनि नन्ही रिया से सौदा करती है: दो पीले गोले, बदले में हरी मिट्टी।
scenes.caption: Avani strikes a swap with little Riya: two yellow balls for some green.
scenes.image_brief: Avani, a five-year-old girl with a short bob and a yellow frock with green buttons, holding out two yellow clay balls on her open palms to Riya, a three-year-old neighbour girl with a single top-knot and a pink kurta, who is offering a fistful of green clay across the craft table.

scenes.narration: नया कछुआ चारों पैरों पर खड़ा हो गया। गोल खोल, नन्हे पैर! अवनि उसे रिया की हथेली पर रख देती है।
scenes.caption: The new turtle stands on all fours. Avani places it in Riya's palm.
scenes.image_brief: Avani, a five-year-old girl with a short bob and a yellow frock with green buttons, setting a small green clay turtle with yellow paws onto the open palm of Riya, a three-year-old neighbour girl with a single top-knot and a pink kurta, both girls leaning over the craft board, warm window light.

scenes.narration: अवनि की मेज़ पर अब पीली मिट्टी नाचती है। गोल खोल, नन्हे पैर!
scenes.caption: Yellow clay dances on her table now. Round shell, tiny feet!
scenes.image_brief: A craft table by a window with a lump of yellow clay half shaped into a snail, Avani, a five-year-old girl with a short bob and a yellow frock with green buttons, humming as she rolls it, the green turtle gone from the board.

title: 🦁 देव का मंच गिरा, दोनों दर्शक चले गए... शेर फिर कैसे दहाड़ा? #hindikids #khel
title_alts: 🎭 देव की उँगलियाँ हिलीं पर जबड़ा बंद रहा, चटाई ख़ाली क्यों हुई? #hindikids #khel
👓 देव ने किससे मंच थामने को कहा, और अधूरा नाटक कैसे पूरा हुआ? #hindikids #khel
description_hook: देव का गत्ते का मंच एक ओर झुककर गिर पड़ा और पर्दे का टेप उखड़ गया। दोनों दर्शक उठकर चले गए।
setting: cardboard stage on a floor mat

characters.name: देव
characters.description: six-year-old boy, short cropped hair, red t-shirt with a yellow collar, grey shorts

characters.name: दादी
characters.description: grandmother, grey hair in a bun, round glasses, green cotton saree

scenes.narration: देव को शेर की कठपुतली से पूरा नाटक दिखाना चाहिए, मंच के पीछे से।
scenes.caption: Dev wants to give a whole show with his lion puppet from behind the stage.
scenes.image_brief: Dev, a six-year-old boy with a short crop of hair and a red t-shirt with a yellow collar, crouching behind a cardboard puppet stage on a woven floor mat, sliding his hand into a soft cloth lion puppet, two cousins sitting cross-legged in front.

scenes.narration: देव हाथ अंदर डालकर उँगलियाँ हिलाता है। मुँह खोलो, शेर दहाड़ो! जबड़ा बंद ही रहा।
scenes.caption: He works his fingers inside and wiggles them. The jaw stays shut.
scenes.image_brief: Dev, a six-year-old boy with a short crop of hair and a red t-shirt with a yellow collar, raising the cloth lion puppet above the cardboard stage, its stitched mouth pressed closed, his wrist twisted awkwardly inside the fabric.

scenes.narration: देव अंगूठा दबाता है, पर कपड़ा अंदर उलझ जाता है। क्या तुम ताली बजा सकते हो?
scenes.caption: He presses with his thumb, and the cloth bunches up inside.
scenes.image_brief: Close view of a cloth lion puppet with its face crumpled and folded, a thumb pushing against the fabric from inside, the cardboard stage edge blurred behind.

scenes.narration: गत्ते का मंच एक ओर झुककर गिर पड़ा, पर्दे का टेप उखड़ गया।
scenes.caption: The cardboard stage leans over and comes down, the curtain tape peeling off.
scenes.image_brief: A cardboard puppet stage collapsed sideways on a woven mat, a cloth curtain hanging from one loose strip of tape, the lion puppet lying on its side nearby.

scenes.narration: दोनों दर्शक उठकर चले गए। चटाई ख़ाली रह गई।
scenes.caption: Both watchers get up and leave. The mat is empty now.
scenes.image_brief: An empty woven floor mat with two flattened cushions on it, a collapsed cardboard stage at the far end, an open doorway with nobody in it, afternoon light.

scenes.narration: देव दादी से पूछता है, मंच थाम लोगी? दादी टेप और एक मोज़ा ले आती हैं।
scenes.caption: Dev asks a question: will you hold the stage? Tape and a sock arrive.
scenes.image_brief: Dev, a six-year-old boy with a short crop of hair and a red t-shirt with a yellow collar, standing at the edge of a doorway asking his grandmother, a woman with a grey bun, round glasses and a green cotton saree, who is holding a roll of tape in one hand and a striped sock in the other.

scenes.narration: दादी मंच थामती हैं, देव की मेहनत की तारीफ़ करती हैं। मुँह खोलो, शेर दहाड़ो! दोनों दर्शक दौड़कर लौट आए।
scenes.caption: She holds the stage and praises his week of practice. The watchers run back.
scenes.image_brief: Dev, a six-year-old boy with a short crop of hair and a red t-shirt with a yellow collar, behind a propped-up cardboard stage with the cloth lion's mouth wide open, his grandmother, a woman with a grey bun, round glasses and a green cotton saree, steadying the stage from the side, two cousins running back to the mat.

scenes.narration: देव का नाटक पूरा हुआ, हँसी से भरा। मुँह खोलो, शेर दहाड़ो!
scenes.caption: His show runs right to the end, full of giggles. Open the mouth, lion, roar!
scenes.image_brief: A cloth lion puppet bowing over the top edge of a mended cardboard stage, Dev, a six-year-old boy with a short crop of hair and a red t-shirt with a yellow collar, grinning beside it, two cousins clapping on the mat, warm evening light.

title: ⚖️ मायरा की डोरी उलझी, नींबू लुढ़क गए... पलड़े बराबर कैसे हुए? #hindikids #khel
title_alts: 🍋 मायरा और नूर ने क्या बदला, और कांटा बीच में कैसे ठहरा? #hindikids #khel
🛍️ एक पलड़ा हवा में उछला, दुकान खुली नहीं... मायरा ने क्या किया? #hindikids #khel
description_hook: मायरा के तराजू की डोरी उलझ गई और दो नींबू अलमारी के नीचे लुढ़क गए। एक तरफ़ फल कम पड़ गए।

characters.name: मायरा
characters.description: five-year-old girl, two pigtails, green apron over a white t-shirt

characters.name: नूर
characters.description: five-year-old girl, short curly hair, orange kurta

scenes.narration: मायरा को तराजू के दोनों पलड़े बराबर चाहिए, दुकान खोलने से पहले।
scenes.caption: Myra wants both pans of her scale level before the shop opens.
scenes.image_brief: Myra, a five-year-old girl with two pigtails and a green apron over a white t-shirt, standing at a low play shop counter beside a small wooden balance scale, a crate of wooden apples and lemons at her elbow, morning light.

scenes.narration: मायरा एक पलड़े में लकड़ी का सेब रखती है। डंडी सीधी, पलड़े बराबर! दूसरा पलड़ा उछल गया।
scenes.caption: She lowers a wooden apple into one pan. The other pan jumps up.
scenes.image_brief: Myra, a five-year-old girl with two pigtails and a green apron over a white t-shirt, placing a red wooden apple into the left pan of a wooden balance scale while the right pan swings high above the counter.

scenes.narration: मायरा उँगली से पलड़ा दबाकर रखती है, पर छोड़ते ही वह उठ जाता है। क्या तुम नींबू गिन सकते हो?
scenes.caption: She holds one pan down with a finger, and it springs up when she lets go.
scenes.image_brief: Close view of a child's finger pressing down the empty right pan of a wooden balance scale, the beam level only under the finger, wooden lemons scattered on the counter.

scenes.narration: पलड़े की डोरी उलझ गई और दो नींबू अलमारी के नीचे लुढ़क गए।
scenes.caption: One pan's string tangles and two lemons roll under the cupboard.
scenes.image_brief: The twisted knotted string of a hanging pan on a wooden balance scale, and two yellow wooden lemons rolling into the dark gap under a cupboard.

scenes.narration: अब एक तरफ़ फल कम पड़ गए। बाकी सेब नूर के पास थे।
scenes.caption: Now one side runs short of fruit. The rest sat in another crate.
scenes.image_brief: A wooden balance scale with one nearly empty pan on a play shop counter, and Noor, a five-year-old girl with short curly hair and an orange kurta, kneeling on the floor nearby with a basket of wooden apples.

scenes.narration: मायरा और नूर सौदा करती हैं: दो सेब इधर, दो नींबू उधर। दोनों मिलकर डोरी सुलझाती हैं।
scenes.caption: The two girls make a swap, then straighten the tangled string together.
scenes.image_brief: Myra, a five-year-old girl with two pigtails and a green apron over a white t-shirt, and Noor, a five-year-old girl with short curly hair and an orange kurta, side by side at the counter, one passing two wooden apples across while the other unpicks the knot in the pan string.

scenes.narration: कांटा बीच में ठहर गया। डंडी सीधी, पलड़े बराबर! मायरा और नूर की तालियाँ एक साथ बजीं।
scenes.caption: The needle settles right in the middle. Both girls clap at the same moment.
scenes.image_brief: A wooden balance scale resting perfectly level with two apples in one pan and two lemons in the other, Myra, a five-year-old girl with two pigtails and a green apron over a white t-shirt, and Noor, a five-year-old girl with short curly hair and an orange kurta, clapping behind the counter.

scenes.narration: मायरा की दुकान खुल गई, दोनों दुकानदार हँसते हैं। डंडी सीधी, पलड़े बराबर!
scenes.caption: The shop is open and both shopkeepers are laughing. Beam straight, pans level!
scenes.image_brief: A play shop counter with a level wooden balance scale, paper price tickets folded blank, Myra, a five-year-old girl with two pigtails and a green apron over a white t-shirt, and Noor, a five-year-old girl with short curly hair and an orange kurta, standing behind it with a basket of wooden fruit.

title: 🔨 नकुल की खूंटी अटक गई, हथौड़े का सिर भी गिरा... छहों कैसे बैठेंगी? #hindikids #khel
title_alts: 🤔 क्यों नकुल ने खूंटी छोड़कर हिलती बेंच को चौखट में फँसा दिया? #hindikids #khel
🪵 बेंच टाइल पर खिसकती रही, नकुल ने असली दिक्कत कहीं और ढूँढ़ी #hindikids #khel
description_hook: नकुल की एक खूंटी खाँचे में अटक गई और हथौड़े का सिर पलंग के नीचे लुढ़क गया। फिर उसे पता चला कि गड़बड़ खूंटी में नहीं थी।

characters.name: नकुल
characters.description: four-year-old boy, round cheeks, green t-shirt and blue shorts, a wooden mallet always in his right hand

scenes.narration: नकुल को बेंच की छहों खूंटियां बराबर नीचे चाहिए। आज ही।
scenes.caption: Nakul wants all six pegs on the bench pressed down level. Today.
scenes.image_brief: Nakul, a four-year-old boy with round cheeks in a green t-shirt and blue shorts, kneeling on a tiled veranda beside a low wooden bench whose six coloured pegs stand at different heights, a wooden mallet in his right hand, morning light.

scenes.narration: नकुल हथौड़ा उठाकर नीली खूंटी पर मारता है। खूंटी सीधी जाने के बदले तिरछी हो जाती है।
scenes.caption: He lifts the mallet and strikes the blue peg. It leans over instead of sinking.
scenes.image_brief: Close view of a wooden mallet coming down on a blue peg that tips sideways in its round hole, Nakul the four-year-old in the green t-shirt gripping the handle with both fists, glossy veranda tiles below.

scenes.narration: फिर वह दो बार ठोकता है — ठक-ठक, खूंटी नीचे! नीली खूंटी हिली भी नहीं।
scenes.caption: He taps twice more. Tap tap, peg goes down! The blue peg does not budge.
scenes.image_brief: Nakul, the four-year-old boy in the green t-shirt and blue shorts, striking the bench twice in a row while the blue peg stays stubbornly crooked and the other pegs rattle, veranda railing behind him.

scenes.narration: हथौड़े का सिर हत्थे से निकलकर पलंग के नीचे लुढ़क गया।
scenes.caption: The mallet head slips off its handle and rolls under the cot.
scenes.image_brief: A round wooden mallet head rolling across tiles into the dark gap under a metal cot, the bare handle lying near Nakul's knee, the four-year-old boy in the green t-shirt stretching an arm after it.

scenes.narration: अब हर ठोक पर बेंच चिकनी टाइल पर खिसक जाती है। खूंटी खाँचे में और कस गई।
scenes.caption: Now every knock slides the bench across the smooth tile. The peg wedges tighter.
scenes.image_brief: The low wooden peg bench skidding a hand's width over glossy veranda tiles with the crooked blue peg jammed deep in its slot, Nakul the four-year-old boy in the green t-shirt chasing it on his knees.

scenes.narration: नकुल खूंटी छोड़ देता है और बेंच को दरवाज़े की चौखट में कसकर फँसा देता है।
scenes.caption: Nakul leaves the peg alone and jams the bench tight into the door frame.
scenes.image_brief: Nakul, the four-year-old boy in the green t-shirt and blue shorts, shoving the wooden bench sideways until it wedges snugly against a wooden door frame threshold, the mallet handle tucked under his arm.

scenes.narration: बेंच टिकी रही, तो हत्थे के दबाव से खूंटियां एक-एक बैठ गईं। नकुल की मुस्कान चौड़ी हो गई। ठक-ठक, खूंटी नीचे!
scenes.caption: Held still, the pegs go down one by one under the handle. His smile spreads wide.
scenes.image_brief: All six coloured pegs sitting flush on the wedged bench while Nakul the four-year-old boy in the green t-shirt presses the last one with the bare mallet handle, grinning broadly, bright veranda light.

scenes.narration: पक्की बेंच, ढीली नहीं। ठक-ठक, खूंटी नीचे!
scenes.caption: A steady bench, never a loose one. Tap tap, peg goes down!
scenes.image_brief: The peg bench wedged calmly in the door frame with every peg level and the mallet handle laid across it, Nakul the four-year-old boy in the green t-shirt standing back with hands on his hips, warm afternoon light.

title: 🛫 सिमरन का विमान दीवार से टकराया, रनवे भी उखड़ा... सिरे तक कौन पहुँचाएगा? #hindikids #khel
title_alts: 🤔 क्यों सिमरन ने पहले भाई का गिरा टावर खड़ा किया, फिर विमान दौड़ाया? #hindikids #khel
🧱 ब्लॉक पूरे रनवे पर बिखरे, और सिमरन को चिकना गत्ता कैसे मिला? #hindikids #khel
description_hook: सिमरन का सफेद विमान मुड़े पहिए के कारण दीवार से जा टकराया, और भाई के ब्लॉक पूरे रनवे पर बिखर गए। उड़ान का रास्ता भाई के पास था।

characters.name: सिमरन
characters.description: six-year-old girl, two short plaits, red sweatshirt and denim skirt, a small white toy jet held in both hands

scenes.narration: सिमरन को अपना सफेद विमान गलियारे के आख़िरी सिरे तक दौड़ाना है।
scenes.caption: Simran wants her white toy jet to run to the far end of the hallway.
scenes.image_brief: Simran, a six-year-old girl with two short plaits in a red sweatshirt and denim skirt, crouched at one end of a long apartment hallway where black tape is laid down as a runway, a small white toy jet on the tape.

scenes.narration: सिमरन विमान को पट्टी पर धकेलती है। अगला पहिया मुड़ा है, विमान दीवार से जा टकराता है।
scenes.caption: She pushes the jet along the strip. A bent nose wheel steers it into the wall.
scenes.image_brief: A small white toy jet veering off a black tape line and bumping the hallway skirting board with its tiny front wheel tilted, Simran the six-year-old girl in the red sweatshirt leaning forward on her palms.

scenes.narration: वह दूसरी बार दौड़ाती है — दौड़ो, दौड़ो, फिर उड़ो! विमान बीच रास्ते रुक जाता है।
scenes.caption: A second run. Run, run, then rise! The jet stalls halfway down.
scenes.image_brief: Simran, the six-year-old girl with two plaits in a red sweatshirt and denim skirt, on her knees pushing the white jet a second time as it halts in the middle of the taped hallway runway.

scenes.narration: छोटे भाई का ब्लॉक-टावर गिरा और टुकड़े पूरे रनवे पर बिखर गए।
scenes.caption: Her little brother's block tower topples and pieces scatter across the runway.
scenes.image_brief: Wooden blocks tumbling from a half-built tower and spreading over a black tape runway in an apartment hallway, a toddler boy in yellow pyjamas sitting beside the fallen pile, the white jet stopped short.

scenes.narration: काली पट्टी उखड़कर अपने ऊपर चिपक गई। रनवे आधा बचा।
scenes.caption: The black tape peels up and sticks to itself. Half the runway is gone.
scenes.image_brief: A length of black tape lifted off the hallway floor and folded onto itself in a crumpled wad, bare floorboards showing where the runway used to be, the white toy jet parked at the ragged edge.

scenes.narration: सिमरन पहले भाई का टावर दोबारा खड़ा करती है, फिर बदले में उसका चिकना गत्ता माँगती है।
scenes.caption: Simran rebuilds her brother's tower first, then asks for his smooth cardboard in return.
scenes.image_brief: Simran, the six-year-old girl in the red sweatshirt and denim skirt, stacking wooden blocks back into a tower for the toddler boy in yellow pyjamas, who holds out a long smooth sheet of cardboard.

scenes.narration: गत्ते की ढलान पर विमान सरपट दौड़कर हाथ में ऊपर उठ गया। सिमरन खिलखिलाकर हँस पड़ी। दौड़ो, दौड़ो, फिर उड़ो!
scenes.caption: Down the cardboard ramp the jet races and lifts into her hand. She laughs out loud.
scenes.image_brief: The white toy jet speeding down a long cardboard ramp and rising into Simran's raised hand, the six-year-old girl in the red sweatshirt laughing, the rebuilt block tower standing beside the toddler boy.

scenes.narration: भाई ताली बजाता है। दौड़ो, दौड़ो, फिर उड़ो!
scenes.caption: Her brother claps along. Run, run, then rise!
scenes.image_brief: Simran and the toddler boy in yellow pyjamas sitting together at the end of the hallway with the cardboard ramp resting on a cushion and the white jet at its top, blocks stacked tidily behind them.

title: 🦆 विहान की बत्तख तली में बैठ गई, नल भी बंद हुआ... खेल कैसे चलेगा? #hindikids #khel
title_alts: 🤔 क्यों विहान को तैरती बत्तख से ज़्यादा छेद वाली बत्तख पसंद आई? #hindikids #khel
💧 मग और बत्तख मिलाकर विहान ने टब में क्या बना दिया? #hindikids #khel
description_hook: विहान चाहता था कि पीली बत्तख सीधी तैरे, पर नीचे के छेद से पानी भरकर वह तली में बैठ गई। वही छेद असली खेल निकला।

characters.name: विहान
characters.description: four-year-old boy, wet curly hair, yellow swim shorts, a yellow rubber duck squeezed in one fist

scenes.narration: विहान को अपनी पीली बत्तख टब के आर-पार सीधी तैरानी है।
scenes.caption: Vihaan wants his yellow duck to sail straight across the tub.
scenes.image_brief: Vihaan, a four-year-old boy with wet curly hair in yellow swim shorts, kneeling at the rim of a white bathtub and holding a bright yellow rubber duck above the still water.

scenes.narration: विहान बत्तख को पानी पर रखता है। वह दो पल तैरकर एक तरफ लुढ़क जाती है।
scenes.caption: He sets the duck on the water. It sails two moments, then rolls on its side.
scenes.image_brief: A yellow rubber duck tipping over onto its side on the surface of bath water with one wing dipping under, Vihaan the four-year-old boy with wet curly hair watching from the tub edge with a dripping hand.

scenes.narration: वह उसे दबाकर हवा भरता है — छप-छप, बत्तख छप! बत्तख फिर टेढ़ी हो जाती है।
scenes.caption: He squeezes air in. Splash splash, duckie splash! It leans over again.
scenes.image_brief: Vihaan, the four-year-old boy in yellow swim shorts, squeezing the yellow rubber duck hard in both fists above the water with bubbles rising, the duck already tilting as he lets go.

scenes.narration: नीचे के छेद से पानी भर गया और बत्तख टब की तली में बैठ गई।
scenes.caption: Water fills through the hole underneath and the duck settles on the tub floor.
scenes.image_brief: A yellow rubber duck resting upside down on the bottom of a bathtub under clear water with a thin line of bubbles leaving the small hole in its base, a blue plastic mug floating above it.

scenes.narration: मम्मी ने नल बंद कर दिया। टब में बस दो बाल्टी पानी बचा।
scenes.caption: Mother closes the tap. Only two buckets of water are left in the tub.
scenes.image_brief: An adult hand turning a chrome tap shut above a bathtub that holds only a shallow layer of water, Vihaan the four-year-old boy with wet curly hair sitting low in the tub beside the sunken duck.

scenes.narration: विहान भरी बत्तख को मग से जोड़ता है और ऊँचा उठाकर छेद से फुहार गिराता है।
scenes.caption: Vihaan pairs the full duck with the mug, lifts it high and rains water from the hole.
scenes.image_brief: Vihaan, the four-year-old boy in yellow swim shorts, holding the water-filled yellow duck high over a blue mug so a fine stream sprays down from the hole in its base into the mug.

scenes.narration: फुहार में उसकी हथेलियाँ भीग गईं, और यह खेल तैरने से भी बढ़िया निकला। विहान खिलखिला उठा। छप-छप, बत्तख छप!
scenes.caption: The spray soaks his palms, and this game beats floating by far. He bubbles with giggles.
scenes.image_brief: Vihaan the four-year-old boy with wet curly hair laughing with his head tipped back as a thin arc of water from the yellow duck splashes onto his open palms and the shallow tub water.

scenes.narration: छेद वाली बत्तख सबसे मज़ेदार। छप-छप, बत्तख छप!
scenes.caption: The duck with a hole is the best fun of all. Splash splash, duckie splash!
scenes.image_brief: The yellow rubber duck sitting on the tub rim with a last drop falling from its base and a blue mug beside it, Vihaan the four-year-old boy wrapped in a striped towel smiling in the doorway.

title: 📷 काव्या की पहली क्लिक हो गई, फिर डिस्क क्यारी में गिरी... कैमरा कैसे चलेगा? #hindikids #khel
title_alts: 🤔 क्यों काव्या की सबसे आसान फोटो ने ही कैमरे को जाम कर दिया? #hindikids #khel
🌹 गीली मिट्टी में फूली डिस्क, और दादी के डिब्बे में क्या निकला? #hindikids #khel
description_hook: काव्या की पहली ही क्लिक मिल गई, और उसी जल्दबाज़ी में लकड़ी की डिस्क क्यारी में जा गिरी। अब गुलाब की फोटो दादी के डिब्बे पर टिकी थी।

characters.name: काव्या
characters.description: five-year-old girl, short bob with a pink clip, purple frock, a pastel wooden toy camera on a cord round her neck

scenes.narration: काव्या को लाल गुलाब की एक फोटो चाहिए, लकड़ी के कैमरे से।
scenes.caption: Kavya wants one picture of the red rose, taken with her wooden camera.
scenes.image_brief: Kavya, a five-year-old girl with a short bob and a pink clip wearing a purple frock, standing before a bed of open red roses and raising a pastel wooden toy camera to her eye.

scenes.narration: पहली ही बार बटन दबा और क्लिक हो गया! काव्या चहकी — क्लिक, क्लिक, एक और क्लिक!
scenes.caption: The very first press clicks! Kavya chirps: Click, click, one more click!
scenes.image_brief: Close view of a small finger pressing the round top button of a pastel wooden toy camera while Kavya the five-year-old girl in the purple frock beams, red roses blurred behind her in morning sun.

scenes.narration: दूसरी बार चक्र घूमा ही नहीं। अंगूठा फिसला और कैमरा घास पर गिरा।
scenes.caption: The second time the ring will not turn. Her thumb slips and the camera drops.
scenes.image_brief: A pastel wooden toy camera lying on garden grass beside Kavya's sandal with its lens ring half turned, the five-year-old girl in the purple frock crouching over it with an empty open hand.

scenes.narration: गिरने से भीतर की गोल लकड़ी की डिस्क छिटककर क्यारी में जा गिरी।
scenes.caption: The fall flings the little round wooden disc out into the flower bed.
scenes.image_brief: A thin round wooden disc lying half buried in dark damp soil among rose stems with a few fallen red petals around it, the open back of the toy camera visible on the grass nearby.

scenes.narration: गीली मिट्टी में डिस्क का किनारा फूल गया। वह खाँचे में लौटी नहीं।
scenes.caption: Damp soil swells the rim of the disc. It will not go back into its slot.
scenes.image_brief: Kavya's fingers holding a muddy wooden disc with a puffed uneven edge above the empty slot inside the pastel toy camera, soil crumbs on her purple frock, the rose bed behind her.

scenes.narration: काव्या दादी से पूछती है, गत्ते का एक गोल ढक्कन मिलेगा? दादी डिब्बा खोल देती हैं।
scenes.caption: Kavya asks her grandmother for a round cardboard lid. Grandmother opens her tin box.
scenes.image_brief: An elderly woman in a grey sari lifting the lid off a round biscuit tin on a garden bench and offering a flat cardboard circle to Kavya, the five-year-old girl in the purple frock reaching up.

scenes.narration: गत्ते का गोल ढक्कन खाँचे में बैठा और कैमरा फिर चल पड़ा। काव्या और दादी साथ हँस पड़ीं। क्लिक, क्लिक, एक और क्लिक!
scenes.caption: The cardboard circle fits the slot and the camera works again. Both of them laugh together.
scenes.image_brief: Kavya the five-year-old girl in the purple frock holding the mended pastel toy camera up toward a red rose while the elderly woman in the grey sari leans in smiling on the garden bench.

scenes.narration: अब कोई जल्दबाज़ी नहीं। क्लिक, क्लिक, एक और क्लिक!
scenes.caption: No rushing any more. Click, click, one more click!
scenes.image_brief: The pastel wooden toy camera hanging on its cord against Kavya's purple frock as she stands calmly among the red roses, the closed biscuit tin on the bench behind her, soft afternoon light.

title: 🧱 तेजस की मीनार दो बार गिरी, फिर मीरा आधी टाइलें ले गई... चौखट तक कैसे? #hindikids #khel
title_alts: 🤝 क्यों तेजस की आधी चुंबकीय टाइलें मीरा की टोकरी में चली गईं? #hindikids #khel
✨ टाइलें आधी रहीं, फिर भी मीनार खिड़की तक पहुँची... किसने पकड़ा आधार? #hindikids #khel
description_hook: तेजस की चुंबकीय मीनार घुटने तक पहुँचकर चटक गई। तभी छोटी मीरा आधी टाइलें अपनी टोकरी में उठा ले गई।

characters.name: तेजस
characters.description: six-year-old boy, short cropped hair, orange polo shirt and navy shorts, bare feet

characters.name: मीरा
characters.description: four-year-old girl, two short braids with pink ribbons, purple kurta and white leggings, carries a woven cane basket

scenes.narration: तेजस को चुंबकीय टाइलों की एक ऊँची मीनार चाहिए, खिड़की की चौखट तक।
scenes.caption: Tejas needs one thing: a magnetic tile tower as tall as the window sill.
scenes.image_brief: Tejas, a six-year-old boy with short cropped hair, an orange polo shirt and navy shorts, kneels on a sunlit wooden living-room floor holding a translucent square magnetic tile up toward a low window sill, a heap of coloured tiles beside his knee, morning light.

scenes.narration: तेजस ने आठ टाइलें जोड़ीं। मीनार दो बार टेढ़ी होकर गिर गई।
scenes.caption: He clicks eight tiles into a stack. It leans and comes down twice.
scenes.image_brief: Tejas, a six-year-old boy with short cropped hair, an orange polo shirt and navy shorts, both hands out in surprise as a column of eight translucent magnetic tiles folds sideways onto the wooden floor, scattered tiles around his feet, morning light.

scenes.narration: तेजस ने नीचे चार टाइलें और लगाईं, मीनार फिर लुढ़क गई। दो हाथ, एक मीनार!
scenes.caption: He adds four tiles at the bottom; it topples again. Two hands, one tower!
scenes.image_brief: Tejas, a six-year-old boy with short cropped hair, an orange polo shirt and navy shorts, pressing four square magnetic tiles into a wider base on the wooden floor while the leaning upper column slumps over, the window sill above him, morning light.

scenes.narration: छोटी बहन मीरा आई और आधी टाइलें उठाकर अपनी टोकरी में डाल लीं।
scenes.caption: Little sister Meera arrives and scoops half the tiles into her basket.
scenes.image_brief: Meera, a four-year-old girl with two short braids tied with pink ribbons, a purple kurta and white leggings, squatting on the sunlit wooden floor dropping fistfuls of coloured translucent magnetic tiles into her woven cane basket, Tejas, a six-year-old boy with short cropped hair, an orange polo shirt and navy shorts reaching after them, morning light.

scenes.narration: बची टाइलों से मीनार घुटने तक ही पहुँची, और एक कोना चटक गया।
scenes.caption: The leftover tiles reach only knee height, and one corner cracks.
scenes.image_brief: A short knee-high tower of translucent magnetic tiles on a sunlit wooden floor with a visible crack along one corner tile, Tejas, a six-year-old boy with short cropped hair, an orange polo shirt and navy shorts crouched beside it with empty hands, morning light.

scenes.narration: तेजस मीरा की टोकरी वाली टाइलें अपनी टाइलों से जोड़ता है; मीरा आधार पकड़ती है।
scenes.caption: He joins her basket tiles onto his own while she grips the base steady.
scenes.image_brief: Tejas, a six-year-old boy with short cropped hair, an orange polo shirt and navy shorts clicking tiles from a woven cane basket onto a growing translucent tower while Meera, a four-year-old girl with two short braids tied with pink ribbons, a purple kurta and white leggings holds the wide base flat with both palms, sunlit wooden floor, morning light.

scenes.narration: दोनों की मीनार खिड़की की चौखट छू गई। तेजस की आँखें चमक उठीं। दो हाथ, एक मीनार!
scenes.caption: Their shared tower touches the sill. His eyes shine. Two hands, one tower!
scenes.image_brief: Tejas, a six-year-old boy with short cropped hair, an orange polo shirt and navy shorts and Meera, a four-year-old girl with two short braids tied with pink ribbons, a purple kurta and white leggings standing on either side of a tall rainbow-coloured magnetic tile tower whose top tile touches a low window sill, both looking up, bright morning light.

scenes.narration: अब तेजस अकेले नहीं जोड़ता। दो हाथ, एक मीनार!
scenes.caption: Tejas does not build on his own any more. Two hands, one tower!
scenes.image_brief: Tejas, a six-year-old boy with short cropped hair, an orange polo shirt and navy shorts and Meera, a four-year-old girl with two short braids tied with pink ribbons, a purple kurta and white leggings sitting side by side on the sunlit wooden floor sharing one heap of translucent magnetic tiles, the finished tall tower beside them, the empty cane basket tipped over, morning light.

title: 🥁 इनाया की ताल तीन बार टूटी, फिर ड्रम का पट्टा खुल गया... घर तक कैसे गूँजी? #hindikids #khel
title_alts: 🤔 क्यों इनाया के बोंगो की आवाज़ अचानक भर्रा गई? #hindikids #khel
👵 दादी रसोई से तीन दिन क्या सुन रही थीं... और ताल कैसे पक्की हुई? #hindikids #khel
description_hook: इनाया के बोंगो ड्रम दीवार से टकराए और उनका पट्टा खुल गया। ढीली खाल पर हर थाप दबकर भर्रा जाती थी।

characters.name: इनाया
characters.description: five-year-old girl, curly shoulder-length hair, green frock, small silver anklets

characters.name: दादी
characters.description: grandmother, grey hair in a low bun, round glasses, white cotton saree with a thin blue border

scenes.narration: इनाया को अपने दो बोंगो ड्रम पर एक पक्की ताल बजानी है।
scenes.caption: Inaya wants one steady rhythm out of her pair of toy bongo drums.
scenes.image_brief: Inaya, a five-year-old girl with curly shoulder-length hair and a green frock, sitting cross-legged on a wooden verandah floor with two small joined toy bongo drums in her lap, palms hovering over the drumheads, soft afternoon light.

scenes.narration: इनाया ने हथेलियों से जल्दी-जल्दी थपकी दी, ताल बीच में ही बिखर गई।
scenes.caption: She slaps fast with both palms and the beat falls apart halfway.
scenes.image_brief: Inaya, a five-year-old girl with curly shoulder-length hair and a green frock, both palms blurred mid-slap over the two toy bongo heads, the drums rocking on the wooden verandah floor, a brass water glass tipping nearby, afternoon light.

scenes.narration: इनाया ने धीमे-धीमे गिनकर कोशिश की, पर हाथ उलझ गए। धिन-धिन धा, धिन-धिन धा!
scenes.caption: She tries slowly, counting, and her hands tangle. Dhin-dhin dha, dhin-dhin dha!
scenes.image_brief: Inaya, a five-year-old girl with curly shoulder-length hair and a green frock, frowning with one palm flat on the left bongo head and her other wrist crossed awkwardly over it, wooden verandah floor, a sleeping cat at the edge of the frame, afternoon light.

scenes.narration: चिकने फर्श पर ड्रम खिसका और दीवार से टकराकर उसका पट्टा खुल गया।
scenes.caption: The drums skid on the smooth floor, hit the wall, and the strap comes undone.
scenes.image_brief: Two small toy bongo drums lying against a green verandah wall with a loose leather strap dangling open from the shell, Inaya, a five-year-old girl with curly shoulder-length hair and a green frock crawling toward them on the polished wooden floor, afternoon light.

scenes.narration: ढीली खाल पर थाप दब गई; ड्रम की आवाज़ भर्रा गई।
scenes.caption: On the slack skin every tap sinks, and the drum goes muffled.
scenes.image_brief: Close view of a slack, dented toy bongo drumhead with the unbuckled strap curling beside it on a wooden verandah floor, Inaya, a five-year-old girl with curly shoulder-length hair and a green frock's small hand resting flat on the loose skin, afternoon light.

scenes.narration: इनाया रसोई में जाकर दादी से पूछती है, पट्टा कसना सिखा दो।
scenes.caption: She walks to the kitchen and asks her grandmother to teach her the buckling.
scenes.image_brief: Inaya, a five-year-old girl with curly shoulder-length hair and a green frock standing in a kitchen doorway holding up the loose-strapped toy bongo drums toward Daadi, a grandmother with grey hair in a bun, round glasses and a white cotton saree who is stirring a steel pot, warm kitchen light.

scenes.narration: दादी बोली, रोज़ तुम्हारा अभ्यास सुनती हूँ। पट्टा कसा, साथ बैठी, ताल नहीं टूटी। धिन-धिन धा, धिन-धिन धा!
scenes.caption: Grandmother says she hears the practice daily, tightens the strap, and sits along. Dhin-dhin dha, dhin-dhin dha!
scenes.image_brief: Daadi, a grandmother with grey hair in a bun, round glasses and a white cotton saree sitting on the wooden verandah floor pulling a leather strap tight on the toy bongo drums while Inaya, a five-year-old girl with curly shoulder-length hair and a green frock drums with both palms beside her, both smiling, golden afternoon light.

scenes.narration: अब घर के सब इनाया की ताल पर सिर हिलाते हैं। धिन-धिन धा, धिन-धिन धा!
scenes.caption: Now the whole house nods along to Inaya's beat. Dhin-dhin dha, dhin-dhin dha!
scenes.image_brief: Inaya, a five-year-old girl with curly shoulder-length hair and a green frock drumming on the tight-strapped toy bongos at the centre of the verandah while Daadi, a grandmother with grey hair in a bun, round glasses and a white cotton saree claps and two neighbours nod from a doorway, evening lamplight.

title: 🛒 सलोनी की ट्रॉली पलटी, फिर पहिया धुरी से निकल गया... फल दुकान तक कैसे? #hindikids #khel
title_alts: 🤔 क्यों सलोनी की भरी खिलौना ट्रॉली कालीन के किनारे पर अटक गई? #hindikids #khel
🍉 आधे फल नन्ही रिया ले गई... और ट्रॉली किसके पास रह गई? #hindikids #khel
description_hook: सलोनी की भरी खिलौना ट्रॉली पिछले पहियों पर पलट गई। फिर अगला पहिया कालीन में फँसकर धुरी से निकल गया।

characters.name: सलोनी
characters.description: four-year-old girl, high ponytail with a green band, yellow frock, red slippers

characters.name: रिया
characters.description: three-year-old girl, short wispy hair, red t-shirt and blue leggings, holds a small cloth basket

scenes.narration: सलोनी को अपनी खिलौना ट्रॉली में सारे फल दुकान तक पहुँचाने हैं।
scenes.caption: Saloni wants all the pretend fruit carried to her play shop in one toy trolley.
scenes.image_brief: Saloni, a four-year-old girl with a high ponytail and a yellow frock, pushing a small metal toy shopping trolley across a patterned carpet toward a low stool set up as a play shop counter, plastic fruit piled on the floor, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: सलोनी ने सेब, केले और तरबूज़ ऊपर की टोकरी में ठूँस दिए। ट्रॉली पिछले पहियों पर पलट गई।
scenes.caption: She crams apples, bananas and a melon into the top basket. The trolley rocks back onto its rear wheels.
scenes.image_brief: Saloni, a four-year-old girl with a high ponytail and a yellow frock stuffing plastic apples, bananas and a large green watermelon into the top basket of a small metal toy trolley that is tilting backwards on the carpet, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: सलोनी ने फल दो बार फिर भरे। भरो, चलाओ, बाँट लो!
scenes.caption: She reloads the fruit twice over. Fill it, roll it, share it out!
scenes.image_brief: Saloni, a four-year-old girl with a high ponytail and a yellow frock kneeling on the patterned carpet gathering scattered plastic fruit back into the upright toy trolley, a spilled orange rolling under a sofa, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: कालीन के किनारे में अगला पहिया फँसा और धुरी से निकल गया।
scenes.caption: A front wheel jams in the carpet edge and pops off its axle.
scenes.image_brief: Close view of a small metal toy trolley stuck at a thick carpet edge with one white plastic front wheel lying loose beside its bare axle, Saloni, a four-year-old girl with a high ponytail and a yellow frock's fingers reaching for the wheel, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: नन्ही रिया आई और आधे फल अपनी कपड़े की टोकरी में भर ले गई।
scenes.caption: Little Riya turns up and carries off half the fruit in her cloth basket.
scenes.image_brief: Riya, a three-year-old girl in a red t-shirt and blue leggings, carrying a small cloth basket walking away across the patterned carpet with plastic apples and grapes heaped in her small cloth basket while Saloni, a four-year-old girl with a high ponytail and a yellow frock kneels by the three-wheeled toy trolley, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: सलोनी रिया की टोकरी मांगकर उसे बदले में ट्रॉली की मूठ थमा देती है।
scenes.caption: She asks for the cloth basket and hands over the trolley handle in exchange.
scenes.image_brief: Saloni, a four-year-old girl with a high ponytail and a yellow frock placing the handle of the small metal toy trolley into the hands of Riya, a three-year-old girl in a red t-shirt and blue leggings, carrying a small cloth basket while lifting the little cloth basket of plastic fruit onto her own hip, patterned carpet, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: दोनों दुकान पहुँचीं, और ट्रॉली रिया के पास ही रह गई। सलोनी ने खुशी से हाँ कर दी। भरो, चलाओ, बाँट लो!
scenes.caption: Both reach the counter and the trolley stays with Riya. Saloni says yes gladly. Fill it, roll it, share it out!
scenes.image_brief: Saloni, a four-year-old girl with a high ponytail and a yellow frock unloading plastic fruit from a cloth basket onto a low stool play shop counter while Riya, a three-year-old girl in a red t-shirt and blue leggings, carrying a small cloth basket stands proudly beside her holding the toy trolley, patterned carpet, warm daylight.

scenes.narration: अब रिया ट्रॉली चलाती है, सलोनी टोकरी। भरो, चलाओ, बाँट लो!
scenes.caption: Now Riya drives the trolley and Saloni takes the basket. Fill it, roll it, share it out!
scenes.image_brief: Riya, a three-year-old girl in a red t-shirt and blue leggings, carrying a small cloth basket pushing the repaired four-wheeled toy trolley along the patterned carpet beside Saloni, a four-year-old girl with a high ponytail and a yellow frock who swings the cloth basket, neat rows of plastic fruit on the stool counter behind them, warm daylight.

title: 🔍 दक्ष का लेंस पत्ते पर धुंधला रहा, फिर दादी की माला टूट गई... मोती कहाँ मिला? #hindikids #khel
title_alts: 🤔 क्यों दक्ष ने पत्ते की नसें छोड़कर गीली मिट्टी पर लेंस घुमाया? #hindikids #khel
💚 कंकड़ों में बिखरे मोती, एक हरा मोती गायब... लेंस ने क्या कर दिखाया? #hindikids #khel
refrain: ज़रा और पास, ज़रा और पास!
description_hook: दक्ष का लकड़ी का लेंस पत्ते की नसें साफ़ नहीं दिखा पाया। तभी दादी की माला का धागा टूटा और मोती कंकड़ों में बिखर गए।

characters.name: दक्ष
characters.description: six-year-old boy, short hair, green t-shirt and khaki shorts, holds a round wooden-handled magnifying glass

characters.name: दादी
characters.description: grandmother, grey hair in a low bun, peach cotton saree, a green beaded necklace

scenes.narration: दक्ष को अपने लेंस से पत्ते की नन्ही नसें बड़ी करके देखनी हैं।
scenes.caption: Daksh wants one thing: the tiny veins of a leaf blown up big.
scenes.image_brief: Daksh, a six-year-old boy with short hair, a green t-shirt and khaki shorts, crouching on a sunny balcony beside a potted fern with a round wooden-handled magnifying glass held over one small green leaf, terracotta pots and gravel around him, morning light.

scenes.narration: दक्ष ने लेंस पत्ते से सटा दिया, नसें धुंधली ही रहीं।
scenes.caption: He presses the lens right onto the leaf and the veins stay blurry.
scenes.image_brief: Close view of a round wooden-handled magnifying glass touching a fern leaf so the glass shows only a soft green smear, Daksh, a six-year-old boy with short hair, a green t-shirt and khaki shorts's squinting face behind it, sunny balcony, morning light.

scenes.narration: दक्ष ने लेंस ऊपर-नीचे किया। ज़रा और पास, ज़रा और पास!
scenes.caption: He slides the lens up and down. A little closer, a little closer!
scenes.image_brief: Daksh, a six-year-old boy with short hair, a green t-shirt and khaki shorts kneeling on a sunny balcony raising and lowering the wooden magnifying glass above a potted fern, his other hand steadying a terracotta pot, morning light.

scenes.narration: तभी दादी की माला का धागा टूटा और मोती कंकड़ों में बिखर गए।
scenes.caption: Just then the thread of grandmother's necklace snaps and beads scatter in the gravel.
scenes.image_brief: Daadi, a grandmother with a grey bun, a peach cotton saree and a green beaded necklace standing on the sunny balcony with a broken thread in her fingers as small green beads bounce and roll across grey gravel and balcony tiles, Daksh, a six-year-old boy with short hair, a green t-shirt and khaki shorts looking down, morning light.

scenes.narration: एक हरा मोती गमले की गीली मिट्टी में गिरकर खो गया।
scenes.caption: One green bead drops into the wet soil of a pot and is lost.
scenes.image_brief: Close view of dark wet soil in a terracotta pot with fern stems, a single green bead half-buried among the crumbs of earth, a watering can spout at the pot rim, morning light.

scenes.narration: दक्ष पत्ता छोड़कर लेंस मिट्टी पर घुमाता है, दादी का मोती ढूँढने।
scenes.caption: He leaves the leaf and sweeps the lens over the soil to hunt her bead.
scenes.image_brief: Daksh, a six-year-old boy with short hair, a green t-shirt and khaki shorts leaning over a terracotta pot moving the round wooden-handled magnifying glass slowly across the wet soil surface, Daadi, a grandmother with a grey bun, a peach cotton saree and a green beaded necklace watching with cupped hands on the sunny balcony, morning light.

scenes.narration: मोती चमका, दादी ने उसे माला में पिरो दिया। दक्ष का सीना गर्व से फूल गया। ज़रा और पास, ज़रा और पास!
scenes.caption: The bead glints, and grandmother threads it back. Daksh swells with pride. A little closer, a little closer!
scenes.image_brief: Daadi, a grandmother with a grey bun, a peach cotton saree and a green beaded necklace threading a small green bead onto a necklace string while Daksh, a six-year-old boy with short hair, a green t-shirt and khaki shorts holds the wooden magnifying glass and beams, the fern pot and gravel behind them, sunny balcony, morning light.

scenes.narration: अब दक्ष का लेंस खोई चीज़ें ढूँढता है। ज़रा और पास, ज़रा और पास!
scenes.caption: Now Daksh's lens goes looking for lost things. A little closer, a little closer!
scenes.image_brief: Daksh, a six-year-old boy with short hair, a green t-shirt and khaki shorts walking along the balcony gravel holding the wooden magnifying glass low over the ground while Daadi, a grandmother with a grey bun, a peach cotton saree and a green beaded necklace wears the mended green beaded necklace and points at a shiny speck, midday light.

title: 🔮 आशी का बड़ा स्टील कंचा अलमारी के नीचे खो गया... तारे तक कौन पहुँचा? #hindikids #khel
title_alts: 🤔 क्यों आशी का सबसे तेज़ कंचा हर बार पहले ही छेद में लुढ़क गया? #hindikids #khel
🐚 एक चमकीली सीपी के बदले छोटा मिट्टी का कंचा... भूलभुलैया पार होगी? #hindikids #khel
description_hook: आशी को लगा कि सबसे तेज़ कंचा ही तारे तक पहुँचेगा। फिर वही तेज़ कंचा अलमारी के नीचे खो गया, और डिब्बी में बस एक छोटा मिट्टी का कंचा बचा।

characters.name: आशी
characters.description: Aashi, a five-year-old girl with a blue hairband, a green kurta and white pyjamas

characters.name: कनु
characters.description: Kanu, a three-year-old boy with a round face, an orange vest and blue shorts

scenes.narration: आशी को बड़ा स्टील का कंचा चाहिए, वही तारे तक सबसे तेज़ पहुँचेगा।
scenes.caption: Aashi wants the big steel marble; the fastest one will reach the star.
scenes.image_brief: Aashi, a five-year-old girl with a blue hairband, a green kurta and white pyjamas, kneeling at a verandah table holding a large shiny steel marble up to the light, a round wooden labyrinth board with grooves and holes in front of her, morning sun on the floor tiles.

scenes.narration: आशी ने भारी कंचा तख्ते पर रखा और झुकाया। कंचा पहले छेद में लुढ़क गया।
scenes.caption: She sets the heavy marble on the board and tilts it. Straight into hole one.
scenes.image_brief: Close view of the steel marble rolling fast along a groove of the round wooden labyrinth and dropping into the first black hole, Aashi's two hands gripping the rim of the board, verandah table edge behind.

scenes.narration: मेरे साथ बोलो: धीरे चल, कंचा धीरे चल! तख्ता फिर भी काबू में नहीं आया।
scenes.caption: Say it with Aashi: slowly now, marble, slowly now! The board still will not obey.
scenes.image_brief: Aashi, the five-year-old girl with a blue hairband, green kurta and white pyjamas, leaning over the labyrinth with her tongue between her teeth, the board tipped steeply to one side, the steel marble blurred with speed.

scenes.narration: तेज़ कंचे ने लकड़ी की दीवार चटकाई, फिर मेज़ से लुढ़ककर अलमारी के नीचे खो गया।
scenes.caption: The speeding marble cracks a wooden wall, then rolls off and vanishes under the cupboard.
scenes.image_brief: A cracked thin wooden wall inside the labyrinth board, and on the floor below a dark gap under a wooden cupboard, Aashi's bare feet and one outstretched arm reaching into the shadow, verandah light behind her.

scenes.narration: कनु ने अपना मिट्टी का कंचा मुट्ठी में बंद कर लिया, बस एक ही बचा था।
scenes.caption: Kanu shuts his clay marble inside his fist. Only that one is left.
scenes.image_brief: Kanu, a three-year-old boy with a round face, an orange vest and blue shorts, sitting cross-legged on the verandah floor with both fists closed tight, a small brown clay marble peeking between his fingers, Aashi watching from the table.

scenes.narration: आशी ने अपनी चमकीली सीपी कनु को दी और बदले में हल्का कंचा ले लिया।
scenes.caption: Aashi hands Kanu her shiny seashell and takes the light clay marble in exchange.
scenes.image_brief: Aashi, the five-year-old girl with a blue hairband, green kurta and white pyjamas, placing a glossy spiral seashell into Kanu's open palm while his other hand drops a small clay marble into hers, both children on the verandah floor.

scenes.narration: धीरे चल, कंचा धीरे चल! हल्का कंचा मुड़ते रास्ते से तारे पर बैठ गया, आशी खिलखिलाई।
scenes.caption: Slowly now, marble, slowly now! The light one curls along and settles on the star.
scenes.image_brief: The small clay marble resting in the painted golden star cup at the centre of the round wooden labyrinth, Aashi laughing with both hands lifted off the board, Kanu clapping beside her at the verandah table.

scenes.narration: आशी अब बड़े कंचे को नहीं ढूँढती। धीरे चल, कंचा धीरे चल!
scenes.caption: Aashi does not hunt for the big marble any more. Slowly now, marble, slowly now!
scenes.image_brief: Aashi, the five-year-old girl with a blue hairband, green kurta and white pyjamas, sitting calm at the verandah table with the clay marble balanced on her fingertip and the labyrinth board flat in front of her, warm afternoon light.

title: 📻 हर्ष का हेलो अलमारी पर बंद हो गया... वीर की आवाज़ कैसे लौटी? #hindikids #khel
title_alts: 🧱 वीर की ब्लॉक मीनार ढही और दोनों वॉकी-टॉकी ऊपर चले गए... अब? #hindikids #khel
🤝 हर्ष ने पहले वीर के ब्लॉक जमाए, बदले में उसने क्या माँगा? #hindikids #khel
description_hook: हर्ष को वॉकी-टॉकी पर बस एक हेलो चाहिए था। पर वीर की मीनार ढह गई, और दोनों वॉकी-टॉकी ऊँची अलमारी पर पहुँच गए।

characters.name: हर्ष
characters.description: Harsh, a six-year-old boy in a red t-shirt and denim shorts, hair parted flat

characters.name: वीर
characters.description: Vir, a six-year-old boy in a yellow t-shirt and grey track pants, curly hair

scenes.narration: हर्ष को वीर से वॉकी-टॉकी पर एक जवाब चाहिए, बस एक हेलो।
scenes.caption: Harsh wants one answer from Vir on the walkie-talkie. Just one hello.
scenes.image_brief: Harsh, a six-year-old boy in a red t-shirt and denim shorts with flat parted hair, crouched inside a cardboard box den holding a black toy walkie-talkie close to his mouth, a hallway visible past the box flap.

scenes.narration: हर्ष ने लाल बटन दबाकर पुकारा। दूसरे कमरे से कोई आवाज़ नहीं आई।
scenes.caption: He presses the red button and calls out. Nothing comes back from the other room.
scenes.image_brief: Close view of Harsh's thumb pressed on the red side button of the toy walkie-talkie, its stubby antenna up, his mouth open mid-call, cardboard wall of the den behind.

scenes.narration: मेरे साथ बोलो: पहले तेरा, फिर मेरा! हर्ष ने फिर दबाया, स्पीकर में सिर्फ़ खरखर।
scenes.caption: Say it with Harsh: yours first, then mine! He tries again and gets only crackle.
scenes.image_brief: Harsh, the six-year-old boy in a red t-shirt and denim shorts, holding the walkie-talkie flat on his palm with his ear bent to the round speaker grille, his eyebrows pulled together, den flap open behind him.

scenes.narration: वीर की ब्लॉक मीनार ढह गई और उसका वॉकी-टॉकी टुकड़ों के नीचे दब गया।
scenes.caption: Vir's block tower collapses and buries his walkie-talkie under the pieces.
scenes.image_brief: A tall tower of coloured plastic blocks toppled across a bedroom floor, a yellow toy walkie-talkie half buried under the scattered blocks, Vir in a yellow t-shirt and grey track pants sitting back on his heels among them.

scenes.narration: माँ ने दोनों वॉकी-टॉकी ऊँची अलमारी पर रख दिए, ब्लॉक समेटने तक।
scenes.caption: Both radios go up onto the high cupboard until the blocks are picked up.
scenes.image_brief: Two toy walkie-talkies standing side by side on the top shelf of a tall wooden cupboard, far above the heads of two small boys looking up from the block-covered floor, hallway door open behind them.

scenes.narration: हर्ष ने वीर के सारे ब्लॉक समेटे, मीनार दोबारा जमाई, और बदले में एक हेलो माँगा।
scenes.caption: Harsh gathers every block, rebuilds the tower, and asks for one hello in return.
scenes.image_brief: Harsh, the six-year-old boy in a red t-shirt and denim shorts, kneeling on the bedroom floor stacking coloured blocks into a rebuilt tower while Vir in a yellow t-shirt steadies the top block with one finger.

scenes.narration: पहले तेरा, फिर मेरा! वीर की हँसती आवाज़ हर्ष के स्पीकर में गूँजी, दोनों मुस्कुराए।
scenes.caption: Yours first, then mine! Vir's laughing voice fills the speaker and both boys grin.
scenes.image_brief: Harsh in his red t-shirt inside the cardboard den holding the walkie-talkie to his ear with a wide grin, and through the open hallway door Vir in his yellow t-shirt laughing into the matching radio beside his rebuilt tower.

scenes.narration: अब हर्ष हर खेल ऐसे ही शुरू करता है। पहले तेरा, फिर मेरा!
scenes.caption: Now Harsh starts every game this way. Yours first, then mine!
scenes.image_brief: Harsh in his red t-shirt and Vir in his yellow t-shirt sitting on the hallway floor with a walkie-talkie each, antennas touching, the rebuilt block tower standing behind them in warm evening light.

title: 🤡 पावनी का जोकर पहले ही चक्कर में उछल पड़ा... फिर मुसीबत शुरू! #hindikids #khel
title_alts: 🔧 क्यों पावनी के लोहे के डिब्बे का ढक्कन बंद ही नहीं हो रहा था? #hindikids #khel
🎵 टूटी कुंडी और अधूरा संगीत... एक रबड़ ने जोकर को कैसे लौटाया? #hindikids #khel
description_hook: पावनी का जोकर पहले ही चक्कर पर बाहर आ गया, और असली मुश्किल वहीं से शुरू हुई। कुंडी टूटी, संगीत बीच में थमा, और ढक्कन बंद होना ही भूल गया।

characters.name: पावनी
characters.description: Paavni, a four-year-old girl in a yellow frock with two small braids

scenes.narration: पावनी को डिब्बे से उछलता जोकर चाहिए, आज पहली बार।
scenes.caption: Paavni wants the clown to spring out of the tin box, her first time ever.
scenes.image_brief: Paavni, a four-year-old girl in a yellow frock with two small braids, sitting on a patterned living room carpet with a brightly painted tin box on her knees, her hand on its small metal crank.

scenes.narration: पहले ही चक्कर पर ढक्कन खुला और जोकर उछल पड़ा। टन टन टन, जोकर आया!
scenes.caption: One turn and the lid flies open, the clown springs up. Ting ting ting, here he comes!
scenes.image_brief: The tin box lid flung wide open on the carpet with a cloth clown on a coiled spring bouncing above it, Paavni in her yellow frock rocking back with her mouth round in surprise.

scenes.narration: मेरे साथ घुमाओ! पावनी ने जोकर को अंदर ठूँसा, पर स्प्रिंग तिरछी बैठ गई।
scenes.caption: Crank along with her! She stuffs the clown back in, but the spring sits crooked.
scenes.image_brief: Close view of Paavni's small hands pushing the cloth clown down into the tin box, the metal coil folding sideways instead of flat, painted flowers on the box side.

scenes.narration: ढक्कन की पीतल की कुंडी टूटकर कालीन के झालर में गिर गई।
scenes.caption: The little brass latch snaps off and drops into the carpet fringe.
scenes.image_brief: A tiny bent brass latch lying lost among the knotted fringe of a living room carpet, the tin box standing open behind it with its lid hanging loose on one hinge.

scenes.narration: अब डिब्बा बंद ही नहीं होता, और संगीत बीच में ही थम गया।
scenes.caption: Now the box will not shut at all, and the tune stops halfway through.
scenes.image_brief: Paavni in her yellow frock pressing the tin lid down with both palms while it springs up again, the clown's cloth arm sticking out of the gap, silent box, carpet floor.

scenes.narration: पावनी ने बालों का रबड़ ढक्कन पर लपेटा और हैंडल धीरे से घुमाया।
scenes.caption: Paavni winds her hair elastic around the lid and turns the crank gently.
scenes.image_brief: A red hair elastic stretched twice around the closed tin box, Paavni's fingers turning the side crank one careful click at a time, her ear tilted toward the box, carpet pattern beneath.

scenes.narration: टन टन टन, जोकर आया! आखिरी सुर पर रबड़ फिसला, जोकर उछला, पावनी खिलखिलाकर हँसी।
scenes.caption: Ting ting ting, here he comes! On the last note the band slips and out he leaps.
scenes.image_brief: The cloth clown bursting up out of the tin box as a red elastic band flies sideways off the lid, Paavni in her yellow frock laughing with both hands on her cheeks on the carpet.

scenes.narration: पावनी अब पूरा गाना सुनकर इंतज़ार करती है। टन टन टन, जोकर आया!
scenes.caption: Paavni waits now for the whole tune to finish. Ting ting ting, here he comes!
scenes.image_brief: Paavni in her yellow frock sitting cross-legged and still on the carpet with one finger resting on the closed tin box lid, the hair elastic around her wrist, soft lamp light.

title: 🌳 रुद्रा का पेड़ ग्यारह बार पलटा... दीदी दरवाज़े से क्या गिन रही थी? #hindikids #khel
title_alts: 🐦 छह चिड़ियाँ और चटकी खूँटी... रुद्रा का संतुलन वाला पेड़ कैसे खड़ा हुआ? #hindikids #khel
📚 एक मोटी किताब तने के नीचे... क्या सारी चिड़ियाँ डाल पर बैठेंगी? #hindikids #khel
description_hook: रुद्रा की चिड़ियाँ हर बार डाल से फिसल जाती थीं, और खूँटी भी चटक गई। दरवाज़े पर खड़ी दीदी उसकी ग्यारह कोशिशें गिन रही थी।

characters.name: रुद्रा
characters.description: Rudra, a five-year-old boy in a blue t-shirt and brown shorts, short cropped hair

characters.name: दीदी
characters.description: Didi, a ten-year-old girl in a pink salwar kameez with a long plait

scenes.narration: रुद्रा लकड़ी के पेड़ पर छहों चिड़ियाँ बिठाना चाहता है।
scenes.caption: Rudra wants all six wooden birds perched on the toy tree.
scenes.image_brief: Rudra, a five-year-old boy in a blue t-shirt and brown shorts with short cropped hair, standing at a study table where a green wooden balance tree rises from a small round base, six painted wooden birds lined up beside it.

scenes.narration: रुद्रा ने दाईं डाल पर तीन चिड़ियाँ रखीं। पेड़ एक तरफ झुक गया।
scenes.caption: He sets three birds on the right branch. The tree leans hard to that side.
scenes.image_brief: Three red and yellow wooden birds crowded on one branch of the wooden balance tree, the whole trunk tipping to the right above the table, Rudra's hands hovering on either side.

scenes.narration: मेरे साथ गिनो! एक इधर, एक उधर! ऊपर की चोटी पर रखी चिड़िया फिसल गई।
scenes.caption: Count with Rudra: one here, one there! The bird on the very top slides off.
scenes.image_brief: Close view of a small blue wooden bird sliding off the pointed top peg of the balance tree, Rudra's fingertip still raised where he placed it, study table wood grain below.

scenes.narration: पूरा पेड़ पलट गया और एक नीली चिड़िया गमले की मिट्टी में गिर पड़ी।
scenes.caption: The whole tree flips over and one blue bird lands in the flowerpot soil.
scenes.image_brief: The wooden balance tree lying on its side across the study table with birds scattered, one blue wooden bird half sunk in the dark soil of a clay flowerpot on the window sill.

scenes.narration: तने की खूँटी चटक गई, अब पेड़ मेज़ पर सीधा खड़ा ही नहीं रहता।
scenes.caption: The trunk peg cracks, so the tree will not stand upright on the table at all.
scenes.image_brief: A hairline crack in the wooden peg at the foot of the balance tree trunk, the tree propped at a slant against a pencil box, Rudra's chin resting level with the table top.

scenes.narration: रुद्रा ने पेड़ उठाया और दीदी से उसकी मोटी नक्शों वाली किताब माँगी।
scenes.caption: Rudra lifts the tree and asks Didi for her thick book of maps.
scenes.image_brief: Rudra, the five-year-old boy in a blue t-shirt and brown shorts, holding the wooden tree trunk upright in both hands and turning toward the doorway where Didi, a ten-year-old girl in a pink salwar kameez with a long plait, holds a thick atlas.

scenes.narration: दीदी ने ग्यारह कोशिशें गिनी थीं, उसने किताब तने के नीचे टिका दी। एक इधर, एक उधर! छहों चिड़ियाँ बैठ गईं और रुद्रा का चेहरा चमक उठा।
scenes.caption: Didi had counted eleven tries. She slides the atlas under the trunk. One here, one there! All six birds perch.
scenes.image_brief: The wooden balance tree standing straight with its cracked peg resting on a thick open atlas, six painted birds spread evenly along the branches, Rudra beaming beside Didi in her pink salwar kameez at the study table.

scenes.narration: रुद्रा हर बार पहले जोड़ी बनाता है। एक इधर, एक उधर!
scenes.caption: Rudra makes a pair first, every single time. One here, one there!
scenes.image_brief: Rudra in his blue t-shirt holding one wooden bird in each hand above the two lowest branches of the balanced tree, the atlas flat beneath the trunk, late afternoon light across the study table.
